description: This source file implements an inter-process communication mechanism for handling execution approvals and command execution requests over Unix domain sockets in a macOS environment. It includes socket management, request-response handling, user prompts via NSAlert, and security features such as HMAC validation.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the approvals socket server, starting and stopping it as needed.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptPresenter
classes.description: Handles the presentation of approval prompts to the user via macOS NSAlert dialog, constructing an accessory view with request details.

classes.name: ExecHostExecutor
classes.description: Contains async logic for validating requests, prompting user for approval, executing commands, and managing allowlists and permissions.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: Implements a Unix domain socket server that handles incoming connection requests for approval prompts and command execution, including security and socket management.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronous method in ExecApprovalsSocketClient that connects to a socket and requests a decision with a timeout.

methods.name: requestDecisionSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous socket communication to request a decision based on a prompt request.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server, initializing accept loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and cleans up socket resources.

methods.name: runAcceptLoop
methods.description: Main accept loop for incoming socket connections.

methods.name: handleClient
methods.description: Handles an individual client connection, processing request and sending responses.

methods.name: sendApprovalResponse
methods.description: Encodes and transmits approval decision responses over the socket.

methods.name: sendExecResponse
methods.description: Encodes and transmits execution command responses.

methods.name: isAllowedPeer
methods.description: Checks if the incoming socket connection is from an authorized peer based on its UID.

methods.name: handleExecRequest
methods.description: Processes an execution request, performing validation, security checks, executing commands, and returning the result.

methods.name: hmacHex
methods.description: Computes a hex-encoded HMAC digest for request validation.
